olivia (customer): Hey support — we've been calling the /v1/rerank endpoint with streaming headers and seeing a 415 + weird scores (all 0.0). It used to work with our old infra. We switched to a streaming client to reduce latency. Example curl below. Any ideas?

olivia (customer): ```bash
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"best restaurants in SF","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"Tom's Diner"},{"id":"b","text":"Bay Bistro"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example.com/v1/rerank
```

olivia (customer): Response is `415 Unsupported Media Type` or sometimes `200` with scores all `0.0`. We also saw spikes in token billing because our retry loop kept resending. Urgent — customer Impact.

maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this — thanks for the repro. Rerank doesn't support SSE/streaming responses currently (only synchronous JSON). The `Accept: text/event-stream` header can cause the gateway to attempt an SSE flow and trigger a 415. Can you try without the `Accept` header? Also confirm the content-type is exactly `application/json`.

olivia (customer): ok trying now, removing Accept header...

olivia (customer): ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"best restaurants in SF","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"Tom's Diner"},{"id":"b","text":"Bay Bistro"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example.com/v1/rerank
```

olivia (customer): Now 200 and scores look sensible. So that confirms it's the stream header. But we got charged a lot during the retries — who can help with credits? @luca (billing)

maya (support): Thanks for confirming. Quick root cause: rerank endpoint is not an SSE endpoint; `Accept: text/event-stream` makes the client expect streaming response and may trigger proxies/path-specific handling. We'll mark this as a documentation/UX gap — we should surface a clearer 415 message for streaming header. I'm tagging eng to track the bug and consider a friendly error. @sam (eng) can you take a look?

sam (eng): looking now. Repro steps match. Gateway receives `Accept: text/event-stream` and our reverse-proxy routes to SSE handler which rejects the content-type for rerank, returning 415. The `200 with 0.0 scores` case looks like a different failure mode where the request body is parsed but the candidates array ends up empty after streaming-chunk parsing. That indicates the streaming client may be chunking the payload in a way our parser doesn't handle for rerank (we expect full JSON body).

sam (eng): immediate mitigation: make the client send the full JSON body with `Content-Type: application/json` and remove SSE/streaming headers. For longer term I'll add stronger validation: if endpoint == /v1/rerank and method == POST then require `Content-Type: application/json` and reject if `Accept: text/event-stream` with a clear message. I'll also add a unit test for chunked transfer bodies to replicate the 0.0-score bug.

maya (support): Thanks. Olivia — we'll follow up with an official patch timeline. For now the workaround is confirmed. Do you need help updating your client? If you share the client lib we can suggest code changes to disable SSE for rerank.

olivia (customer): We use node-fetch + eventsource polyfill. We had a shared fetch wrapper that sets `Accept: text/event-stream` globally which caused other endpoints to trip too. We'll patch it. Can you also confirm whether those retry attempts will be refunded? We consumed ~9k tokens from retries in the last hour.

luca (billing): I can take a look — can you DM the account id or invoice id? We can provisionally credit charges caused by a platform mis-route while we investigate. If it's confirmed the requests were malformed (Accept header) we typically still offer goodwill credits for spike accidents during an outage window. DM me and I'll open a billing ticket.

olivia (customer): DMing account id now. Appreciate it.

sam (eng): follow-ups for eng backlog: 1) add explicit 415 message text: "rerank endpoint only supports application/json POST bodies; remove streaming Accept header" 2) hard-fail on chunked/streamed body for rerank with `400` if JSON isn't fully parsable 3) add telemetry to detect repeated `Accept: text/event-stream` calls and surface a doc link in the error. I'll create a PR and link here.

rerank-bot: New issue created: RED-RE-RERANK-1825 — "SSE Accept header accepted by gateway causing 415/0.0 scores" (https://redwood-internal/issue/RED-RE-RERANK-1825)

maya (support): Filing internal KB so support can quickly triage: short checklist (1) Ask customer to remove `Accept: text/event-stream` (2) Ensure `Content-Type: application/json` and full JSON body (3) If retries spiked billing, escalate to billing with invoice ID (4) If they need low-latency streaming, recommend using our streaming-capable generation endpoints instead of rerank.

olivia (customer): Thanks everyone — reproducer confirmed and we rolled back the wrapper. Waiting on billing DM. Will ping if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:

maya (support): Closing the thread for now but will update when eng PR lands. Thanks for the fast repro, @olivia (customer).
